messages:
lina: Quick thread  enterprise asks: require approvals for presets that materially change cost/quota. thinking `approval_required` flag + approvers list on preset create. want API + console UX suggestions.

 tom: +1. Need audit trail + immutable commit id. also enforce server-side: if preset would push projected monthly cost delta > $500 or token delta > 10% route quota, auto mark approval_required.

 marta: UX notes: show a red shield icon on the preview when approval_required. primary CTAs: "request approval" (creates request) and "simulate for approver" (provides approver-only view with extra details). keep regular flow for non-enterprise.

 raj: telemetry/tracing: include `preset_request_id` and `preview_id` tags. spans should carry `requested_by`, `approver`, and `approval_state` so analysts can join traces to approval events. also return `preview_provenance` so billing joins are correct.

 security-bot: security-bot: policy update suggestion: approval_required when `estimated_monthly_cost_delta > 500 || estimated_token_increase_pct > 10`. also require approver role `presets.approve`.

 lina: sketching API contract for approval flow:
 ```json
{
  "preset_id": "p-1999-approval",
  "scope": {"route_id": "r-99", "model": "rwin-enterprise"},
  "preview": {"aggregate_tokens": 120000, "estimated_cost_monthly_delta": 742.50, "cache_effect_adjustment": 0.12, "preview_provenance": "14d_hist"},
  "approval_required": true,
  "approval_state": "pending",
  "approvers": ["alice@example.com","bob@example.com"],
  "approval_history": [{"actor":"carol","action":"requested","ts":"2025-05-01T15:03:20Z","note":"projected cost jump"}],
  "audit_log_ref": "audit:log:2025-05-01:pv-1999",
  "preview_id": "pv-1999"
}
```

 marta: console behavior: when approval_required show inline CTA "request approval" which opens modal allowing user to add note and select approvers (defaults from org policy). modal creates `preset_request_id` and emails approvers + shows dry-run traces checkbox. approver modal includes a side-by-side before/after quota table + p95 worst-case.

 raj: server should validate approvers list against org directory and cap approver count to 5. on commit the server emits `commit_id` and an immutable audit entry: `{commit_id, preset_id, actor, ts, preview_id, approval_state}`. include `trace_key:console.presets.commit.v1` in spans.

 security-bot: add retention note: approval_history and audit_log_ref must be kept for 2 years for enterprise customers.

 ops-bot: ops-bot: FYI canary window for approval-flow backend: 2025-06-10T12:00:00Z (team: eng-platform).

 tom: approver flow: when approver opens request, call endpoint `/v1/presets/request/:id/approver_preview` which returns extra fields: `post_commit_quota_delta`, `projected_monthly_cost`, `linked_billing_ids`, and `estimated_risk` (low/med/high). approver can approve/reject with optional note. server returns 403 if user lacks `presets.approve`.

 lina: added requirement: requests should be linkable from audit export CSV by `preset_request_id` and `commit_id`. analytics folks want `preview_id` in both preview and commit events to join across pipelines.

 marta: microcopy: approval modal header: "Request approval to commit preset"; approver modal header: "Review preset impact (approver view)". warn text: "Approving will schedule changes and may affect billing. Review projected monthly delta and quota impact."

 raj: tracing plan: add span tags: `route:<id>`, `preset:<id>`, `preview_id:<id>`, `preset_request_id:<id>`, `commit_id:<id>`, `requested_by:<email>`, `approver:<email>`, `approval_state:<pending|approved|rejected>`, `preview_provenance:<string>`. ensure logs include structured `estimate_basis` fields so DataStudio joins are stable.

 security-bot: security-bot: one more: require MFA for approvers on approvals that exceed $2000 projected monthly delta.

 lina: OK action items: (1) marta - wire modal prototype with shield icon / request approval / approver preview; (2) raj - implement `/v1/presets/request` and `/approve` endpoints + stable span tags; (3) tom - add server-side guardrail thresholds and audit log entries; (4) security - finalize retention and MFA policy. sync Tue 10am PT to finalize API fields and audit schema. short thread.
